senses.gloss:
mfn. (-पन्-पन्ती-पत्)
Speaking, talking.
E.
प्र before लप to speak, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Said, spoken, declared.
E.
प्र before लप to speak, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं)
1 Hanging down, depending from, pendulous.
2 Slow, dilatory.
m. (-म्बः)
1 Depending, hanging on or from.
2 The new shoot or bud of a creeping plant.
3 A garland of flowers worn round the neck.
4 A branch.
5 The female breast.
6 Tin.
7 The name of a Daitya, killed by BALARĀMA.
E.
प्र before लवि to oppose, aff. घञ्.

n. (-म्बं)
A garland hanging round the neck, and reaching to the breast.
E.
प्र and आङ् before लवि to hang or fall, aff. अच्; also with कन् added प्रालम्बक.

m. (-घ्नः)
A name of BALARĀMA.
E.
प्रलम्ब a demon, killed by BALADEVA, and घ्न who kills; also similar compounds, as प्रलम्बभित्, &c.

m. (-भित्)
BALADEVA, the brother of KṚṢṆA.
E.
प्रलम्ब, and भित् who destroys: see the last.

m. (-ण्डः)
A man having large testicles.
E.
प्रलम्ब pendulous, and अण्ड testicle.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Suspended, pendulous, hanging.
E.
प्रलम्ब hanging, इतच् aff.

mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं)
Over-reached, cheated, deceived.
E.
प्र before लभ to gain, क्त aff.

m. (-म्भः)
Fraud, cheating.
E.
प्र before लभि to get, घञ् aff.

m. (-यः)
1 The end of a Kalpa, or destruction of the world.
2 Death, dying, loss, destruction, dissolution, annihilation.
3 Fainting, syncope, loss of sense or consciousness.
E.
प्र before ली to destroy, aff. अच्.

m. (-पः)
1 Unmeaning or incoherent speech.
2 Speaking.
3 Discourse, conversation.
E.
प्र before लप to speak, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि)
1 Talking much, or unmeaningly, chattering.
2 Speaking to, conversing with.
E.
प्र before लप to speak, घिनुण् aff.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Who or what smears, plasters, &c.
E.
प्र before लिप to anoint, क aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Destroyed, annihilated.
2 Unconscious, insensible.
E.
प्र before ली to destroy, क्त aff.

f. (-ता)
1 Destruction, annihilation.
2 The end of the universe.
3 Unconsciousness, loss of sense.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, प्रलीनत्वं.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what anoints, smears, &c.
m. (-कः)
1 A plasterer.
2 A slow fever.
E.
प्र before लिप to smear, aff. ण्वुल्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Rolling, heaving, tossing.
E.
प्र before लुठ to roll, क्त aff.

n. (-नं)
Rolling on the ground, heaving, tossing, (as of the ocean.)
E.
प्र before लुठ to roll, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-भः)
Desire, cupidity.
E.
प्र before लुभ to covet, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Allurement, inducement.
2 Attraction, attracting, seducing.
E.
प्र before लुभ to desire, ल्युट् aff.

f. (-का)
A garland, a necklace.
E.
प्रालम्ब a garland, &c. कन् aff., fem. form.

n. (-यं)
Frost.
E.
प्र before लीच् to unite with, aff. अच्; प्रलय here said to mean a mountain, अण् aff. of derivation, and the penultimate vowel changed to ए.

m. (-शुः)
The moon.
E.
प्रालेय frost or cold, and अंशु a ray.
